m.d: Your eyes are the part of your head which you see with.
m.e: We saw the eyes of a big wolf.

m.d: An eye is a hole at the blunt end of a needle through which thread is passed.
To look at carefully or with interest .
An eyewitness is someone who saw the crime in question.
Your eyesight is your ability to see.
m.e: The motorist lost his eyesight after an accident with a lorry.

m.d: An eyeball is the entire round part of an eye, including the hidden part.
m.e: The doctor checked my eyeball when I got my new glasses.

m.d: If you eyeball something, you estimate or judge it; you look at it.
The eyebrow is the hair that grows on the bony ridge above the eye.
An eyelash is one of the hairs that grows on the eyelid.
The eyelid is a piece of skin that covers the eye. The eyelid can move back, allowing the eye to "open".
m.e: The doctor looked at his eyelids.
